predecessors.name: Republic of Pisa
predecessors.text: Piombino, Populonia, Suvereto, Scarlino, Buriano, San Pancrazio al Fango and Elba (page lists Pianosa and Montecristo too)

successors.name: Principality of Lucca and Piombino
successors.text: Piombino, Populonia, Suvereto, Scarlino, Buriano, San Pancrazio al Fango and Elba (page lists Pianosa and Montecristo too)

ledger.x: 1399: Gherardo Appiani receives Piombino, Populonia, Suvereto, Scarlino, Buriano, San Pancrazio al Fango, Pianosa, Montecristo and Elba by cession of 19 February 1399; Pisa goes to the Visconti.
1805: the principality is annexed to the Principality of Lucca and Piombino on 23 June 1805.

certainty.note: No frontier on the page; Elba shared with Spain/Medici from 1557; Follonica not named.
